browserCommands.regression: ARTPLAYER_BROWSER_ARTIFACTS=refactor/.cache/mod03-slider-main-map.json; baseline unset; yarn test:browser test/browser/accessibility-slider.spec.js test/browser/progress-quality.spec.js --workers=1

limits: 18 paired cases cover two formats and three groups per engine; each pair has two runs. Remaining 66 ordinary browser cases include historical baselines, not all candidate tests.
Timings use 300 warmup and five samples of 1000 synthetic paused timeupdate calls. No mutation observer in the timed loop; browser timer precision still limits interpretation.
Separate native playback checks confirm live ARIA values; playback windows have slightly different event counts.
Some timed groups are slower; no total playback FPS or broad performance gain is claimed.
MutationObserver no longer receives redundant equal-value ARIA records; all public media/setBar events and final ARIA values remain.
Storage cadence, layout/initialization profiling and full actual-installed BASE-06 pairing remain for MOD-03. ENG-PERF-01/02 stay open.
No public types, dependencies, versions, physical devices, remote CI or publication changed.

Committed summaries aggregate identical duplicate mutation names by attribute; complete original records remain in the archived raw Playwright reports with their SHA-256. Raw timing samples are retained in this summary.
